### Fresh Gospel Wine in Naboth’s Vineyard
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/finding-fresh-gospel-wine-in-naboths-vineyard/
Passage: 1 Kings 21:3
Points:
- Naboth refused Ahab’s proposal because the land was a sacred inheritance received from God.
- Ahab sulked over the refusal, prompting Jezebel to orchestrate Naboth’s murder under false pretenses.
- Naboth’s faithful refusal and unjust death foreshadow Jesus, who would not forfeit His covenant inheritance.
- Though wicked rulers thought they achieved victory, Christ ultimately overturned evil and destroyed the devil’s schemes.
